findings.subject: POD total mass
findings.message: The pod is about 429.3 kg against the 420 kg cap (D-37, D-54): 9.3 kg over. The layout study's list gives 426.7 kg (v2/05-Engineering/layout-study/out/parts-option-B1-final-stack.csv); adjustments since: +11.8 kg AIR-D60 (confirmed, D-61 and D-71 (decision log, 2026-10-31)); +3.4 kg WALL-TRAY-LIPS (confirmed, D-69 and D-71 (decision log, 2026-10-31)); -12.6 kg FLOOR-9MM (confirmed, D-72 and D-71 (decision log, 2026-10-31)). Open against the cap until the wall sample settles it (ISS-080).
findings.fix: Find the weight, or the PM rules on the cap after the wall sample (D-54: the 25 kg/m3 fill would save 4.3 kg).
